title_tag: 靠5美元衣服横扫全球，Shein如今上市就破发：欧美年轻人不买了吗？—— 英国路透社外刊讲解第1155天
h1: 靠5美元衣服横扫全球，Shein如今上市就破发：欧美年轻人不买了吗？
category: 英国路透社外刊讲解 第1155天
nav_hint: Shein shares slide in Hong Kong debut

headline.en_html: Shein shares slide in Hong Kong debut on worries about trade and regulatory risks
headline.zh: Shein香港上市首日股价下 跌，贸易与监管风险引发 担忧

notes.en: slide (v.) means to decline or fall gradually, especially in value or price
notes.ctx: （Shein上市首日股价）下跌，下滑
notes.ex1: Tech stocks slid sharply after the company issued a weak earnings forecast. 在这家公司发布疲软的盈利预期后，科技股大幅下挫。
notes.ex2: Consumer confidence continued to slide for the third consecutive month. 消费者信心连续第三个月持续下滑。

notes.en: debut (n.) means the first public appearance or launch of something, such as a company on the stock market
notes.ctx: Shein在香港交易所的上市首日，首次公开交易
notes.ex1: The band's debut album topped the charts within a week of its release. 这支乐队的首张专辑在发行一周内就登上了排行榜榜首。
notes.ex2: Her debut on the New York stage was met with enthusiastic reviews from critics. 她在纽约舞台的首次亮相获得了评论家的热烈好评。

paragraphs.en_html: Shares in online fast-fashion <mark class="voc">retailer</mark> Shein fell 8% in their first day of Hong Kong trade on Tuesday, with investors worried about <mark class="voc">setbacks</mark> that long <mark class="voc">delayed</mark> its listing and <mark class="voc">undermined</mark> its <mark class="voc">competitive advantages</mark>. The stock fell as much as 10% despite only 6.6% of the company being <mark class="voc">floated</mark>. Shein raised about $1.7 billion in the IPO, which valued the company at around $26.5 billion — far below its 2022 peak of nearly $100 billion.
paragraphs.zh: 周二，在线快时尚零售商 Shein 在香港上市首日股价下跌8%，投资者担忧的是那些曾导 致其上市计划长期搁置、并削弱其竞争优势的重重阻碍。尽管此次上市流通的股份仅占 公司总股本的6.6%，股价盘中跌幅仍一度达到10%。Shein通过此次首次公开募股（IPO） 筹集了约17亿美元，公司估值约265亿美元——远低于2022年近1000亿美元的峰值。

notes.en: retailer (n.) means a person or business that sells goods directly to consumers
notes.ctx: 在线快时尚零售商Shein，直接面向消费者销售商品的企业
notes.ex1: The electronics retailer announced plans to close 50 underperforming stores nationwide. 这家电子产品零售商宣布计划在全国范围内关闭50家业绩不佳的门店。
notes.ex2: Online retailers have forced traditional brick-and-mortar shops to rethink their business models. 在线零售商迫使传统实体店重新思考其商业模式。

notes.en: setback (n.) means a problem or difficulty that delays or reverses progress
notes.ctx: 曾导致Shein上市计划长期搁置的种种挫折与阻碍
notes.ex1: The company suffered a major setback when regulators rejected its merger application. 当监管机构驳回其合并申请时，该公司遭受了重大挫折。
notes.ex2: Despite several setbacks in clinical trials, the pharmaceutical firm remains committed to the drug's development. 尽管临床试验屡遭挫折，这家制药公司仍致力于该药物的研发。

notes.en: delay (v.) means to make something happen later than originally planned
notes.ctx: 使Shein的上市计划长期延后
notes.ex1: Bad weather delayed the satellite launch for a third time this month. 恶劣天气使卫星发射本月第三次推迟。
notes.ex2: The board voted to delay the shareholder meeting until the audit was completed. 董事会投票决定将股东大会推迟到审计完成之后。

notes.en: undermine (v.) means to gradually weaken or damage something, such as power, confidence, or an advantage
notes.ctx: 削弱了Shein原有的竞争优势
notes.ex1: Constant price cuts have undermined the brand's reputation for quality. 不断降价削弱了该品牌在质量方面的声誉。
notes.ex2: The scandal undermined public trust in the financial regulator. 这起丑闻削弱了公众对金融监管机构的信任。

notes.en: competitive advantage (n.) means a condition or capability that allows a company to outperform its rivals
notes.ctx: Shein凭借超快供应链和低价直邮建立起来的竞争优势
notes.ex1: The firm's proprietary technology gives it a lasting competitive advantage in the chip market. 该公司的专有技术使其在芯片市场拥有持久的竞争优势。
notes.ex2: Cheap labour is no longer a reliable competitive advantage as automation spreads. 随着自动化的普及，廉价劳动力不再是可靠的竞争优势。

notes.en: float (v.) means to sell shares in a company to the public for the first time
notes.ctx: Shein此次仅让6.6%的公司股份上市流通
notes.ex1: The founders decided to float the company on the London Stock Exchange last year. 创始人去年决定让公司在伦敦证券交易所上市。
notes.ex2: Only a small percentage of the business was floated to maintain family control. 公司仅将一小部分股份上市以维持家族控制。

paragraphs.en_html: The <mark class="voc">debut</mark> <mark class="voc">caps</mark> a four-year effort to <mark class="voc">tap</mark> public markets. Shein initially pursued a New York listing before turning to London, but intense <mark class="voc">scrutiny</mark> of its business practices in the West and regulatory <mark class="voc">obstacles</mark> frustrated both attempts. Hong Kong eventually became its <mark class="voc">destination</mark>. The dramatic fall in valuation reflects how much has changed since the pandemic <mark class="voc">e-commerce</mark> boom, when social-media influencers <mark class="voc">showing off</mark> “Shein <mark class="voc">hauls</mark>” helped turn the company into one of the world’s fastest-growing fashion <mark class="voc">retailers</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 此次上市，也为 Shein 长达四年的公开市场上市之路画上了句号。Shein最初寻求在纽约 上市，之后转向伦敦，但西方对其商业行为的严格审视以及监管方面的障碍，使这两次 尝试均未能如愿。最终，香港成为了它的上市目的地。估值的大幅缩水，反映出自疫情 期间电商繁荣以来，市场已经发生了多么巨大的变化——彼时，社交媒体上的网红纷纷 展示自己的“Shein购物战利品”，推动这家公司一跃成为全球增长最快的时尚零售商之 一。

notes.en: debut (n.) means the first public appearance or launch of something, such as a company on the stock market
notes.ctx: Shein在香港交易所的上市首日，首次公开交易
notes.ex1: The band's debut album topped the charts within a week of its release. 这支乐队的首张专辑在发行一周内就登上了排行榜榜首。
notes.ex2: Her debut on the New York stage was met with enthusiastic reviews from critics. 她在纽约舞台的首次亮相获得了评论家的热烈好评。

notes.en: cap (v.) means to bring something to a conclusion or put an end to a process
notes.ctx: 此次上市为Shein长达四年的上市之路画上了句号
notes.ex1: The signing ceremony capped months of intense negotiations between the two sides. 签约仪式为双方数月紧张的谈判画上了句号。
notes.ex2: A spectacular fireworks display capped the week-long festival. 一场壮观的烟花表演为期一周的节日画上了句号。

notes.en: tap (v.) means to access or make use of a resource or market
notes.ctx: Shein为进入公开资本市场所做的努力
notes.ex1: The startup is looking to tap international markets to fuel its next phase of growth. 这家初创公司希望开拓国际市场以推动下一阶段的增长。
notes.ex2: The company tapped the bond market to raise funds for its expansion plan. 该公司进入债券市场为扩张计划筹集资金。

notes.en: scrutiny (n.) means close and critical examination or inspection
notes.ctx: 西方对Shein商业行为的严格审视
notes.ex1: The company's labour practices came under intense scrutiny from human rights groups. 该公司的劳工行为受到了人权组织的严密审查。
notes.ex2: Public spending on infrastructure projects faces growing scrutiny as budget pressures mount. 随着预算压力加大，基础设施项目的公共支出面临越来越多的审查。

notes.en: obstacle (n.) means something that blocks progress or makes it difficult to achieve a goal
notes.ctx: 使Shein在纽约和伦敦上市受挫的监管障碍
notes.ex1: High tariffs remain a major obstacle to entering the Southeast Asian market. 高关税仍是进入东南亚市场的主要障碍。
notes.ex2: Regulatory approval is the biggest obstacle standing between the drug and its commercial launch. 监管审批是该药物实现商业化上市所面临的最大障碍。

notes.en: destination (n.) means the place where someone or something finally ends up or is chosen to go
notes.zh: 目的地，最终选择的地方
notes.ctx: 香港最终成为Shein选择的上市地点
notes.ex1: After considering several overseas exchanges, Singapore became the company's listing destination. 在考虑了多家海外交易所之后，新加坡成为了该公司的上市目的地。
notes.ex2: The coastal city has become a popular destination for tech startups seeking a friendlier regulatory environment. 这座沿海城市已成为寻求更友好监管环境的科技初创公司的热门选择。

notes.en: e-commerce (n.) means the buying and selling of goods and services over the internet
notes.ctx: 疫情期间电商繁荣所推动的在线零售增长
notes.ex1: E-commerce sales surged during the holiday season as shoppers avoided crowded stores. 假日季期间，由于购物者避开拥挤的商店，电商销售额大幅增长。
notes.ex2: The logistics company has invested heavily in warehouses to support the rapid growth of e-commerce. 这家物流公司大举投资仓储设施，以支持电子商务的快速增长。

notes.en: show off (phr. v.) means to display something proudly or in a way that attracts attention
notes.ctx: 网红在社交媒体上展示自己购买的Shein商品
notes.ex1: The influencer showed off her latest fashion purchases in a video that drew millions of views. 这位网红在一段视频中展示了她最新的时尚购物成果，吸引了数百万次观看。
notes.ex2: He couldn't resist showing off his new sports car to his colleagues. 他忍不住向同事们炫耀他的新跑车。

notes.en: haul (n.) means a large quantity of items bought or collected at one time, especially in the context of shopping
notes.zh: （一次购买的）大量物品，购物战利品
notes.ctx: 网红展示的一次性购买的Shein商品
notes.ex1: She posted a video of her latest beauty haul, featuring dozens of budget-friendly products. 她发布了一段最新美妆购物分享视频，展示了数十款平价产品。
notes.ex2: The holiday shopping haul included gifts for the entire family. 这次假日购物收获包括给全家人的礼物。

notes.en: retailer (n.) means a person or business that sells goods directly to consumers
notes.ctx: 在线快时尚零售商Shein，直接面向消费者销售商品的企业
notes.ex1: The electronics retailer announced plans to close 50 underperforming stores nationwide. 这家电子产品零售商宣布计划在全国范围内关闭50家业绩不佳的门店。
notes.ex2: Online retailers have forced traditional brick-and-mortar shops to rethink their business models. 在线零售商迫使传统实体店重新思考其商业模式。

paragraphs.en_html: Known globally for selling $5 <mark class="voc">tops</mark> and $10 dresses, Shein built its success around an extraordinarily fast supply chain and the ability to ship cheap products directly from China to consumers. But tariff and <mark class="voc">duty</mark> changes in the United States and Europe have weakened that advantage. The removal of the U.S. “de minimis” <mark class="voc">exemption</mark> for low-value <mark class="voc">parcels</mark> and similar changes in Europe have made cheap cross-border shipping more expensive, putting pressure on the model that fuelled Shein’s global expansion.
paragraphs.zh: Shein以5美元的上衣和10美元的连衣裙闻名全球，它的成功建立在一条速度惊人的供应 链之上，同时还能将廉价商品从中国直接运送到消费者手中。然而，美国和欧洲关税及 税收政策的变化，已经削弱了这一优势。美国取消针对低价值包裹的“最低限额免税” （de minimis）政策，欧洲也采取了类似调整，这使得廉价的跨境运输成本不断上升，也 给曾经推动 Shein 全球扩张的商业模式带来了压力。

notes.en: top (n.) means a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body
notes.ctx: Shein销售的5美元上衣
notes.ex1: She paired the striped top with a simple pair of jeans. 她用这件条纹上衣搭配了一条简单的牛仔裤。
notes.ex2: The store is selling basic cotton tops for just a few dollars each. 这家商店出售的基础款棉质上衣每件只要几美元。

notes.en: duty (n.) means a tax imposed on goods imported from another country
notes.ctx: 美国和欧洲对进口商品征收的关税
notes.ex1: The government raised import duties on foreign textiles to protect domestic manufacturers. 政府提高了对外国纺织品的进口关税以保护国内制造商。
notes.ex2: Consumers will bear the cost of higher duties on electronic goods. 消费者将承担电子产品关税提高所带来的成本。

notes.en: exemption (n.) means official permission not to do something or pay something that others must do or pay
notes.ctx: 美国对低价值包裹的“最低限度免税”待遇
notes.ex1: Small shipments under a certain value enjoy a tax exemption in many countries. 在许多国家，低于一定价值的小额包裹享受免税待遇。
notes.ex2: The new policy removes the duty exemption previously granted to low-cost imports. 新政策取消了此前给予低价进口商品的关税豁免。

notes.en: parcel (n.) means a package or object wrapped for delivery by post or courier
notes.ctx: 从中国直接寄给消费者的低价值包裹
notes.ex1: The courier left the parcel at the front door since no one was home. 由于无人在家，快递员把包裹放在了前门。
notes.ex2: Customs officials inspected thousands of parcels arriving from overseas each day. 海关官员每天检查数千件从海外寄来的包裹。

paragraphs.en_html: At the same time, growth has become more expensive to <mark class="voc">sustain</mark>. Revenue growth slowed from 21% to 8%, while marketing expenses rose faster than revenue in 2025. Shein reported a $99 million net loss in the first quarter of 2026, compared with a $395 million profit a year earlier. Investors are increasingly asking whether the company can continue expanding its user base without customer <mark class="voc">acquisition</mark> becoming substantially more costly.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，维持增长所需要付出的成本也越来越高。Shein的营收增速从21%放缓至8%， 而2025年营销费用的增长速度却超过了营收。2026年第一季度，Shein录得9900万美元净 亏损，而一年前同期则实现了3.95亿美元的利润。投资者越来越担心的是：如果获取新客 户的成本大幅上升，Shein还能否继续扩大自己的用户群体。

notes.en: sustain (v.) means to maintain or keep something going at a certain level or rate
notes.ctx: 维持Shein的增长需要付出更高的成本
notes.ex1: The company struggled to sustain its rapid growth as competition intensified. 随着竞争加剧，该公司难以维持其快速增长。
notes.ex2: Investors question whether the current profit margins can be sustained in the long term. 投资者质疑目前的利润率能否长期维持。

notes.en: acquisition (n.) means the act of obtaining or gaining something, especially in business contexts such as customers or companies
notes.ctx: 获取新客户
notes.ex1: Customer acquisition costs have risen sharply across the online retail sector. 整个在线零售行业的获客成本都大幅上升。
notes.ex2: The company's growth strategy relies heavily on the acquisition of smaller rivals. 该公司的增长战略在很大程度上依赖于对较小竞争对手的收购。

paragraphs.en_html: Competition is another problem. Shein faces rivals including Temu and AliExpress while consumers have become less <mark class="voc">responsive</mark> to the <mark class="voc">ultra</mark>-cheap cross-border model. Daily active users in Europe have fallen around 45% since the EU <mark class="voc">scrapped</mark> its <mark class="voc">duty</mark> <mark class="voc">exemption</mark> on small <mark class="voc">parcels</mark>. One analyst described this as less a problem unique to Shein than “the end of an era for cheap cross-border shipping”. Shein’s enormous global reach remains an advantage, but much of its customer loyalty has always belonged to the <mark class="voc">price tag</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 竞争是另一个问题。Shein不仅面临 Temu 和 AliExpress 等竞争对手，与此同时，消费者 对于这种超低价跨境购物模式的反应也不再像过去那般热烈。自欧盟取消小额包裹的关 税豁免政策以来，Shein在欧洲的日活跃用户数量已经下降约45%。一位分析师认为，这 与其说是 Shein 独有的问题，不如说是“廉价跨境运输时代的终结”。Shein庞大的全球 市场覆盖仍然是一项优势，但一直以来，它相当一部分的客户忠诚度，其实属于那个诱 人的价格标签。

notes.en: responsive (adj.) means reacting quickly and positively to something
notes.ctx: 消费者对超低价跨境购物模式的反应不再热烈
notes.ex1: Shoppers have become less responsive to aggressive online advertising campaigns. 消费者对激进的网络广告活动反应已不如从前。
notes.ex2: The market was highly responsive to the company's announcement of a new product line. 市场对该公司推出新产品线的消息反应非常积极。

notes.en: ultra (pref.) means extremely; beyond the usual range or limit
notes.ctx: 超低价的跨境购物模式
notes.ex1: The retailer built its brand around ultra-cheap fashion items aimed at young consumers. 这家零售商围绕面向年轻消费者的超低价时尚单品打造了自己的品牌。
notes.ex2: Ultra-fast delivery services have transformed customer expectations in big cities. 超快配送服务改变了大城市消费者的预期。

notes.en: scrap (v.) means to cancel or abandon a plan, policy, or system
notes.ctx: 欧盟取消了对小额包裹的关税豁免政策
notes.ex1: The government decided to scrap the tax break after evidence of widespread abuse emerged. 在出现广泛滥用的证据后，政府决定取消这项税收优惠。
notes.ex2: The airline scrapped its plans to launch direct flights to the region. 这家航空公司取消了开通该地区直飞航班的计划。

notes.en: duty (n.) means a tax imposed on goods imported from another country
notes.ctx: 美国和欧洲对进口商品征收的关税
notes.ex1: The government raised import duties on foreign textiles to protect domestic manufacturers. 政府提高了对外国纺织品的进口关税以保护国内制造商。
notes.ex2: Consumers will bear the cost of higher duties on electronic goods. 消费者将承担电子产品关税提高所带来的成本。

notes.en: exemption (n.) means official permission not to do something or pay something that others must do or pay
notes.ctx: 美国对低价值包裹的“最低限度免税”待遇
notes.ex1: Small shipments under a certain value enjoy a tax exemption in many countries. 在许多国家，低于一定价值的小额包裹享受免税待遇。
notes.ex2: The new policy removes the duty exemption previously granted to low-cost imports. 新政策取消了此前给予低价进口商品的关税豁免。

notes.en: parcel (n.) means a package or object wrapped for delivery by post or courier
notes.ctx: 从中国直接寄给消费者的低价值包裹
notes.ex1: The courier left the parcel at the front door since no one was home. 由于无人在家，快递员把包裹放在了前门。
notes.ex2: Customs officials inspected thousands of parcels arriving from overseas each day. 海关官员每天检查数千件从海外寄来的包裹。

notes.en: price tag (n.) means the cost or value of something, especially when seen as a key factor in decision-making
notes.ctx: Shein客户的忠诚度很大程度上属于那个诱人的低价
notes.ex1: Consumers are drawn to the store by its low price tags rather than product quality. 消费者被这家商店低廉的价格所吸引，而非产品质量。
notes.ex2: The new model comes with a hefty price tag that may deter budget-conscious buyers. 这款新型号的标价高昂，可能会让注重预算的买家望而却步。

paragraphs.en_html: That helps explain why investors remained cautious even after Shein’s huge valuation <mark class="voc">reset</mark>. At around 15 times forward earnings, the company came to market at more than twice PDD’s multiple despite weaker growth visibility and significant regulatory and trade risks. A heavily <mark class="voc">discounted</mark> valuation, analysts warned, is not necessarily the same thing as a cheap stock. The market is increasingly treating Shein less like a disruptive high-growth technology platform and more like a <mark class="voc">retailer</mark> facing <mark class="voc">margin</mark> and <mark class="voc">execution</mark> pressures.
paragraphs.zh: 这也有助于解释，为什么即使 Shein 的估值已经经历了大幅重估，投资者依然保持谨 慎。按照约15倍的预期市盈率计算，Shein上市时的估值倍数是拼多多的两倍以上，尽 管其增长前景更加不明朗，同时还面临显著的监管和贸易风险。分析师警告说，估值 被大幅压低，并不一定意味着这只股票真的便宜。 市场越来越不再把 Shein 看作一个 具有颠覆性的高增长科技平台，而是将其视为一家面临利润率和执行压力的零售企业。

notes.en: reset (n.) means the act of adjusting something back to a previous or lower level
notes.ctx: Shein估值经历的大幅重估
notes.ex1: The stock market crash forced a painful reset in tech company valuations. 股市暴跌迫使科技公司估值经历痛苦的重新调整。
notes.ex2: The economic downturn triggered a reset in consumer spending habits. 经济低迷引发了消费者支出习惯的重置。

notes.en: discounted (adj.) means reduced in price or value; marked down
notes.ctx: Shein估值被大幅压低，以折价状态进入市场
notes.ex1: Investors were cautious about buying even heavily discounted shares in the struggling retailer. 即使这家陷入困境的零售商股价已大幅折价，投资者仍对买入持谨慎态度。
notes.ex2: The discounted valuation reflects the market's concerns about future profitability. 折价估值反映了市场对未来盈利能力的担忧。

notes.en: retailer (n.) means a person or business that sells goods directly to consumers
notes.ctx: 在线快时尚零售商Shein，直接面向消费者销售商品的企业
notes.ex1: The electronics retailer announced plans to close 50 underperforming stores nationwide. 这家电子产品零售商宣布计划在全国范围内关闭50家业绩不佳的门店。
notes.ex2: Online retailers have forced traditional brick-and-mortar shops to rethink their business models. 在线零售商迫使传统实体店重新思考其商业模式。

notes.en: margin (n.) means the difference between the cost of producing or buying something and the price at which it is sold
notes.ctx: Shein面临的利润率压力
notes.ex1: Rising shipping costs have squeezed profit margins across the e-commerce industry. 不断上涨的运输成本挤压了整个电商行业的利润率。
notes.ex2: The company is shifting toward higher-margin products to offset declining sales volume. 该公司正转向利润率更高的产品，以抵消销量下滑的影响。

notes.en: execution (n.) means the act of carrying out or implementing a plan or strategy effectively
notes.ctx: Shein在运营执行层面面临的压力
notes.ex1: The strategy was sound, but poor execution led to disappointing results. 战略本身没有问题，但执行不力导致了令人失望的结果。
notes.ex2: Investors are concerned about the company's execution capabilities in new markets. 投资者对该公司在新市场的执行能力感到担忧。

paragraphs.en_html: Shein is trying to change that story. One potentially important shift is its gradual transformation from a <mark class="voc">pure</mark> <mark class="voc">retailer</mark> into a retailer-plus-platform. <mark class="voc">Third-party</mark> brands increasingly sell through Shein, allowing the company to generate service revenue and <mark class="voc">monetise</mark> its infrastructure beyond its own inventory. It is also becoming less dependent on <mark class="voc">apparel</mark>, expanding into categories such as home and living. The goal is to turn Shein’s supply-chain and customer-<mark class="voc">acquisition</mark> capabilities into a broader lifestyle commerce platform.
paragraphs.zh: Shein正在努力改变这一局面。一个可能具有重要意义的转变，是它正在逐渐从一家纯 粹的零售商，转型为“零售商+平台”的模式。越来越多的第三方品牌开始通过 Shein 销售商品，这使公司能够获得服务收入，并在自有库存之外进一步将其基础设施转化为 收益。与此同时，Shein也在降低对服装业务的依赖，向家居和生活用品等品类扩张。 其目标，是将 Shein 在供应链和获客方面的能力，转化为一个覆盖范围更加广泛的生活 方式电商平台。

notes.en: pure (adj.) means complete and total; not mixed with anything else
notes.ctx: Shein正从一家纯粹的零售商转型
notes.ex1: The company was once a pure hardware manufacturer before expanding into software. 该公司在扩展到软件领域之前曾是一家纯粹的硬件制造商。
notes.ex2: Few pure online retailers remain as most have adopted hybrid offline strategies. 纯粹的在线零售商已经很少，因为大多数都采取了线上线下混合策略。

notes.en: retailer (n.) means a person or business that sells goods directly to consumers
notes.ctx: 在线快时尚零售商Shein，直接面向消费者销售商品的企业
notes.ex1: The electronics retailer announced plans to close 50 underperforming stores nationwide. 这家电子产品零售商宣布计划在全国范围内关闭50家业绩不佳的门店。
notes.ex2: Online retailers have forced traditional brick-and-mortar shops to rethink their business models. 在线零售商迫使传统实体店重新思考其商业模式。

notes.en: third-party (adj.) means belonging to or involving an entity other than the two main parties involved
notes.ctx: 第三方品牌通过Shein平台销售商品
notes.ex1: The platform allows third-party sellers to list products alongside its own inventory. 该平台允许第三方卖家在自有库存之外上架产品。
notes.ex2: Third-party logistics providers handle delivery for many small online retailers. 第三方物流供应商为许多小型在线零售商处理配送业务。

notes.en: monetise (v.) means to convert something into a source of income or profit
notes.ctx: Shein将自身基础设施转化为收益来源
notes.ex1: The app monetises its large user base through advertising and premium subscriptions. 这款应用通过广告和付费订阅将其庞大的用户基础变现。
notes.ex2: The company is looking for new ways to monetise the data it has collected. 该公司正在寻找将所收集数据变现的新途径。

notes.en: apparel (n.) means clothing, especially in the context of the fashion industry
notes.ctx: Shein正在降低对服装业务的依赖
notes.ex1: The brand is best known for its affordable athletic apparel. 该品牌以其价格实惠的运动服装而闻名。
notes.ex2: The apparel industry faces growing pressure to adopt more sustainable practices. 服装行业在采用更可持续的生产方式方面面临越来越大的压力。

notes.en: acquisition (n.) means the act of obtaining or gaining something, especially in business contexts such as customers or companies
notes.ctx: 获取新客户
notes.ex1: Customer acquisition costs have risen sharply across the online retail sector. 整个在线零售行业的获客成本都大幅上升。
notes.ex2: The company's growth strategy relies heavily on the acquisition of smaller rivals. 该公司的增长战略在很大程度上依赖于对较小竞争对手的收购。

paragraphs.en_html: Yet <mark class="voc">diversification</mark> brings risks <mark class="voc">of its own</mark>. <mark class="voc">Hosting</mark> <mark class="voc">third-party</mark> <mark class="voc">merchants</mark> creates additional compliance and reputational challenges at a time when Shein is already under intense regulatory <mark class="voc">scrutiny</mark>. Its weak trading <mark class="voc">debut</mark> also <mark class="voc">stands in contrast with</mark> the extraordinary investor <mark class="voc">appetite</mark> surrounding Chinese companies in artificial intelligence, robotics and memory chips. Those are the sectors where investors currently see structural growth and where demand for new listings has been strongest.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，多元化本身也会带来新的风险。在 Shein 已经面临严格监管审查之际，引入第三 方商家又会带来额外的合规与声誉挑战。与此同时，Shein上市首日的疲软表现，也与 投资者对中国人工智能、机器人和存储芯片企业表现出的强烈热情形成鲜明对比。目前， 投资者正是在这些行业中看到了结构性增长，而市场对于这些行业新股上市的需求也最 为旺盛。

notes.en: diversification (n.) means the process of expanding into new products, markets, or business areas to reduce risk
notes.ctx: Shein向平台模式和家居等新品类扩张的多元化战略
notes.ex1: The company's diversification into financial services has helped stabilise its revenue. 该公司向金融服务的多元化发展帮助稳定了其收入。
notes.ex2: Diversification across multiple product lines can cushion a firm against market downturns. 跨多个产品线的多元化可以缓冲企业面临的市场低迷。

notes.en: of one's own (phr.) means belonging to or characteristic of oneself
notes.ctx: 多元化本身也会带来其自身的风险
notes.ex1: Every investment strategy has risks of its own that must be carefully weighed. 每一种投资策略都有其自身的风险，必须仔细权衡。
notes.ex2: The new approach brings advantages, but it also has challenges of its own. 新方法带来了优势，但也有其自身的挑战。

notes.en: host (v.) means to provide the space, infrastructure, or platform for something or someone
notes.ctx: Shein为第三方商家提供销售平台
notes.ex1: The website hosts thousands of independent sellers from around the world. 该网站为来自世界各地的数千家独立卖家提供平台。
notes.ex2: The marketplace hosts both established brands and small independent merchants. 该市场平台既容纳知名品牌，也容纳小型独立商家。

notes.en: third-party (adj.) means belonging to or involving an entity other than the two main parties involved
notes.ctx: 第三方品牌通过Shein平台销售商品
notes.ex1: The platform allows third-party sellers to list products alongside its own inventory. 该平台允许第三方卖家在自有库存之外上架产品。
notes.ex2: Third-party logistics providers handle delivery for many small online retailers. 第三方物流供应商为许多小型在线零售商处理配送业务。

notes.en: merchant (n.) means a person or business that buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities or through a particular platform
notes.ctx: 在Shein平台上销售商品的第三方商家
notes.ex1: Small merchants on the platform often struggle with rising commission fees. 该平台上的小商户常常因佣金上涨而苦苦挣扎。
notes.ex2: The e-commerce giant has attracted millions of merchants from across the country. 这家电商巨头吸引了来自全国各地的数百万商家。

notes.en: scrutiny (n.) means close and critical examination or inspection
notes.ctx: 西方对Shein商业行为的严格审视
notes.ex1: The company's labour practices came under intense scrutiny from human rights groups. 该公司的劳工行为受到了人权组织的严密审查。
notes.ex2: Public spending on infrastructure projects faces growing scrutiny as budget pressures mount. 随着预算压力加大，基础设施项目的公共支出面临越来越多的审查。

notes.en: debut (n.) means the first public appearance or launch of something, such as a company on the stock market
notes.ctx: Shein在香港交易所的上市首日，首次公开交易
notes.ex1: The band's debut album topped the charts within a week of its release. 这支乐队的首张专辑在发行一周内就登上了排行榜榜首。
notes.ex2: Her debut on the New York stage was met with enthusiastic reviews from critics. 她在纽约舞台的首次亮相获得了评论家的热烈好评。

notes.en: stand in contrast with (phr.) means to be noticeably different from something else, especially in a way that highlights the difference
notes.ctx: Shein首日疲软表现与投资者对中国AI等企业的热情形成鲜明对比
notes.ex1: The company's sluggish growth stands in sharp contrast with the rapid expansion of its rivals. 该公司的缓慢增长与其竞争对手的快速扩张形成鲜明对比。
notes.ex2: The cautious mood in the retail sector stands in contrast with the optimism in technology markets. 零售行业的谨慎情绪与科技市场的乐观氛围形成鲜明对比。

notes.en: appetite (n.) means a strong desire or willingness to have, buy, or invest in something
notes.zh: 强烈的兴趣，投资热情，需求
notes.ctx: 投资者对中国AI、机器人和存储芯片企业的强烈投资热情
notes.ex1: Investor appetite for new energy stocks has cooled since the market correction. 市场回调以来，投资者对新能源股票的热情有所降温。
notes.ex2: There is strong appetite among global funds for high-growth technology listings. 全球基金对高增长科技公司上市存在强烈的投资需求。

paragraphs.en_html: Shein’s Hong Kong <mark class="voc">debut</mark> therefore marks a striking <mark class="voc">reversal</mark> from the optimism surrounding the company four years ago. In 2022, it was a nearly $100 billion private company, celebrated as one of China’s most successful global consumer brands. Today it is worth roughly a quarter of that peak and faces slower growth, tougher trade rules, <mark class="voc">fierce</mark> competition and persistent regulatory <mark class="voc">scrutiny</mark>. Shein spent a decade proving how many consumers would buy a $5 dress. Its first day in Hong Kong showed that shoppers and <mark class="voc">shareholders</mark> may be buying two very different things.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，Shein此次香港上市，标志着市场情绪与四年前围绕这家公司形成的乐观氛围相 比，出现了一次令人瞩目的逆转。2022年，它还是一家估值接近1000亿美元的非上市公 司，被誉为中国最成功的全球消费品牌之一。如今，它的估值仅约为巅峰时期的四分之 一，同时还面临增长放缓、贸易规则趋严、激烈竞争以及持续不断的监管审查。Shein 用了十年时间证明，究竟有多少消费者愿意购买一条5美元的连衣裙。而香港上市首日 的表现则表明：消费者愿意买的东西，与股东愿意买的东西，或许完全是两回事。

notes.en: debut (n.) means the first public appearance or launch of something, such as a company on the stock market
notes.ctx: Shein在香港交易所的上市首日，首次公开交易
notes.ex1: The band's debut album topped the charts within a week of its release. 这支乐队的首张专辑在发行一周内就登上了排行榜榜首。
notes.ex2: Her debut on the New York stage was met with enthusiastic reviews from critics. 她在纽约舞台的首次亮相获得了评论家的热烈好评。

notes.en: reversal (n.) means a complete change in a situation, direction, or trend to the opposite
notes.ctx: Shein上市首日表现与四年前乐观氛围相比出现的惊人逆转
notes.ex1: The company's declining sales marked a sharp reversal from its years of rapid expansion. 该公司销售额的下滑标志着其多年来快速扩张的急剧逆转。
notes.ex2: The policy change represents a major reversal in the government's approach to foreign investment. 这一政策变化代表着政府对待外资方式的重大转变。

notes.en: fierce (adj.) means very strong, intense, or aggressive
notes.ctx: Shein面临的来自Temu和AliExpress等的激烈竞争
notes.ex1: The smartphone market is characterised by fierce competition among a handful of major brands. 智能手机市场的特点在于少数几大品牌之间竞争激烈。
notes.ex2: Fierce price wars have eroded profits across the discount retail sector. 激烈的价格战侵蚀了整个折扣零售行业的利润。

notes.en: scrutiny (n.) means close and critical examination or inspection
notes.ctx: 西方对Shein商业行为的严格审视
notes.ex1: The company's labour practices came under intense scrutiny from human rights groups. 该公司的劳工行为受到了人权组织的严密审查。
notes.ex2: Public spending on infrastructure projects faces growing scrutiny as budget pressures mount. 随着预算压力加大，基础设施项目的公共支出面临越来越多的审查。

notes.en: shareholder (n.) means a person or organisation that owns shares in a company
notes.ctx: 股东愿意买的东西与消费者愿意买的东西是两回事
notes.ex1: Shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favour of the proposed merger. 股东以压倒性多数投票支持拟议的合并。
notes.ex2: The company's decision to cut dividends angered many long-term shareholders. 该公司削减股息的决定激怒了许多长期股东。

proper.name: Shein / 希音
proper.def:
成立于中国、总部后迁新加坡的在线快时尚零售平台，以5美元上衣、10美元连衣裙的极低价格、极快上新速度和强大的中国供应链著称，依托广州番禺服装集群实现“小单快反”，每天上新数千款。
本文中的意思：全文主角，正处在上市首日破发、估值大幅缩水的转折点。

proper.name: Hong Kong debut / 港股首秀
proper.def:
指Shein股票首次在香港交易所公开挂牌交易。港交所是全球主要证券市场之一，对中国背景公司而言是连接国际资本的重要桥梁，上市须满足财务披露、公司治理、市值等多项条件。
本文中的意思：Shein在纽约、伦敦尝试受阻后的最终上市地，首日即告下跌。

proper.name: IPO / 首次公开募股
proper.def:
即Initial Public Offering，指私人公司首次向公众投资者发行新股并在交易所挂牌上市，既为募集资金，也为早期投资者提供退出通道，流程包括选聘投行、尽职调查、监管审核、路演定价等。
本文中的意思：Shein通过此次IPO筹集了约17亿美元。

proper.name: Valuation / 估值
proper.def:
市场或机构对公司整体经济价值的评估：上市公司最直接的指标是市值（股价×总股本），未上市公司则由融资轮次中的投资方出价决定。
本文中的意思：Shein本次IPO估值约265亿美元，较2022年私募融资时近1000亿美元的峰值缩水约四分之三。

proper.name: New York listing / 纽约上市
proper.def:
指在纽交所或纳斯达克挂牌上市。纽约是全球资本市场核心枢纽，能带来极高的国际曝光度与充裕流动性，但SEC信息披露要求极严，近年对中概股的审计底稿、数据安全审查日趋收紧。
本文中的意思：Shein最初的上市首选，因西方对其商业行为的严格审视而未能如愿。

proper.name: London listing / 伦敦上市
proper.def:
指在伦交所主板或AIM挂牌上市。伦敦是欧洲最大的股票交易市场和重要国际金融中心，监管相对灵活，但仍须满足英国金融行为监管局（FCA）的上市规则与持续披露义务。
本文中的意思：Shein转战的第二站，因供应链劳工、关税待遇等密集审查最终未能成行。

proper.name: Social-media influencers / 社交媒体网红
proper.def:
在Instagram、TikTok、YouTube等平台持续输出内容、积累大量粉丝的个人创作者，能对粉丝的消费决策产生实质性影响，“种草”营销是当代数字营销的核心手段。
本文中的意思：Shein早期大量与中腰部网红合作、免费寄品换曝光，以极低获客成本实现病毒式传播的关键推手。

proper.name: Shein haul / Shein开箱购物视频
proper.def:
“Haul”本意“大量购买”，在社交媒体语境下特指博主一次性展示从某品牌购买的大量商品并逐件试穿评价的视频，2020年前后是YouTube和TikTok上的火爆内容类别。
本文中的意思：这些几乎免费的用户生成内容为Shein带来巨大流量，推动其在欧美年轻女性中走红。

proper.name: Pandemic e-commerce boom / 疫情期间电商繁荣
proper.def:
2020—2022年疫情期间，封锁与社交距离限制使线下零售遭受重创，线上购物需求井喷，服装等品类渗透率急剧上升。
本文中的意思：Shein黄金期的起点——消费者被迫线上买衣服且更偏好低价，其销售额与用户数倍增，2022年估值冲上近1000亿美元。

proper.name: Supply chain / 供应链
proper.def:
从原材料采购、加工、质检、仓储到跨境配送的完整商品流通链条。Shein以广州番禺数千家中小工厂为核心，用自研系统实时对接订单与产能，设计到上架仅需7—14天，远快于ZARA的3—4周。
本文中的意思：Shein成功的基石，也是被关税政策削弱的那种竞争优势所在。

proper.name: De minimis exemption / 小额免税政策
proper.def:
“De minimis”为拉丁语“关于微小事物”，指对低价值进口包裹免征关税的规则。美国此前允许800美元以下包裹免税入境，欧盟门槛为22欧元，Shein、Temu借此直邮低价商品、规避关税。
本文中的意思：2025年前后美欧相继取消或收紧该政策，直接推高Shein的物流与税费成本。

proper.name: Cross-border shipping / 跨境直邮
proper.def:
商品从中国经国际快递或邮政渠道直接送达海外消费者的物流方式，省去海外仓备货环节，适合小批量多批次订单，库存集中、资金占用少。
本文中的意思：Shein早期赖以扩张的模式，但对运费和关税政策极为敏感，免税收紧后成本劣势日益凸显。

proper.name: Revenue growth / 营收增长率
proper.def:
（本期营收−上期营收）÷上期营收×100%，衡量公司业务扩张速度的核心财务指标，反映销售拓展能力与产品吸引力。
本文中的意思：Shein营收增速从21%放缓至8%，说明高速扩张期已过，直接引发投资者对其盈利前景的重估与估值下调。

proper.name: Marketing expenses / 营销费用
proper.def:
公司为获取新用户、维护老用户和推广品牌投入的开支，包括广告投放、网红合作、关键词竞价、促销折扣等，获客成本（CAC）是衡量营销效率的关键指标。
本文中的意思：2025年Shein营销费用增速超过营收增速，意味着每单位新增收入所需付出的营销成本越来越高。

proper.name: Net loss / net profit / 净亏损与净利润
proper.def:
净利润是总收入扣除全部成本、费用、税收和利息后的最终盈利，是最综合的经营成果指标；收入不抵支出则为净亏损。
本文中的意思：Shein 2026年一季度净亏损9900万美元，而上年同期盈利3.95亿美元，一正一负说明盈利能力严重恶化。

proper.name: Temu / 特木
proper.def:
拼多多母公司PDD Holdings于2022年9月在美国推出的跨境电商平台，主打极致低价，靠“全托管模式”（商家只管发货，平台包办定价、物流、售后）和大规模社媒投放迅速扩张。
本文中的意思：与Shein目标用户、品类和价格带高度重叠的最直接竞争对手。

proper.name: AliExpress / 全球速卖通
proper.def:
阿里巴巴2010年推出的面向国际消费者的跨境电商零售平台，常被称为“国际版淘宝”，覆盖服装、电子、家居等全品类，在俄罗斯、欧洲、巴西用户基础深厚，物流依托菜鸟网络。
本文中的意思：与Shein、Temu形成直接竞争关系的又一对手。

proper.name: Daily active users / 日活跃用户数（DAU）
proper.def:
一天内至少有一次主动访问或使用行为的独立用户数量，是衡量互联网平台用户规模与粘性的核心运营指标。
本文中的意思：欧盟取消小额包裹免税后Shein售价上涨，其欧洲DAU下降约45%，消费者购买意愿显著减弱。

proper.name: EU scrapped its duty exemption / 欧盟取消小额包裹关税豁免
proper.def:
欧盟此前对从非欧盟国家进口的22欧元以下小包裹免征关税和增值税，极大便利了Shein、Temu对欧直邮。
本文中的意思：欧盟逐步收紧并于2025年前后正式取消免税门槛，所有包裹须报关缴税，直接导致Shein欧洲售价上升、用户流失。

proper.name: End of an era for cheap cross-border shipping / 廉价跨境直邮时代终结
proper.def:
分析师对行业趋势的概括：依赖美欧小额免税红利、以极低物流税费成本直销全球的商业模式已走到尽头，行业将被迫向海外仓备货、品牌化升级等更重资产方向转型。
本文中的意思：说明Shein的困境不是个案，而是整个低价跨境电商赛道的大环境变了。

proper.name: Forward P/E ratio / 前瞻市盈率
proper.def:
当前股价除以未来12个月的预期每股收益（EPS），反映市场对公司未来盈利能力的预期定价，比静态市盈率更侧重增长前景。
本文中的意思：Shein上市时约15倍，是拼多多（约7倍）的两倍以上——增长更差、风险更大却更贵，分析师因此提醒“估值打折不等于股票便宜”。

proper.name: Retailer-plus-platform / 零售商+平台模式
proper.def:
从纯自营零售转向“自营+第三方商家入驻”的混合商业模式：零售赚商品差价，平台则收取佣金、广告费、物流服务费等，边际利润率通常更高、资产更轻。
本文中的意思：Shein正开放第三方品牌入驻，目标是升级为覆盖多品类的生活方式电商平台。

proper.name: AI / robotics / memory chips / 人工智能、机器人与存储芯片
proper.def:
当前全球科技投资最热门的三大赛道：AI涵盖机器学习与大语言模型，机器人包括工业与服务机器人，存储芯片（DRAM、NAND Flash）是半导体核心品类，均受益于结构性增长动力。
本文中的意思：与Shein首日冷清形成鲜明对比——投资者更青睐硬核科技资产，港股A股相关IPO需求极为旺盛。

sources_note: 资料核对：原文与数据依据路透社2026年9月1日报道《Shein shares slide in Hong Kong debut on worries about trade and regulatory risks》（作者 Yantoultra Ngui、Selena Li、Kane Wu），背景知识参考港交所《上市规则》及美国SEC、欧盟委员会公开政策文件。

practice.intro: 把下面几句翻译成英文，注意用上本课学过的表达。
items: 由于持续降雨，气温大幅下降，许多游客纷纷穿上外套。
缺乏经验可能会削弱团队在比赛中的竞争优势。
学校取消了原定于周五举行的户外活动。
这家餐厅凭借超低的价格标签吸引了大量年轻顾客。
引入新的合作伙伴固然能带来资源，但也伴随着自身的问题。
她对这份工作的热情与他消极的态度形成了鲜明对比。
practice.critical_en: Shein spent a decade proving how many consumers would buy a $5 dress. Its first day in Hong Kong showed that shoppers and shareholders may be buying two very different things.
practice.critical_zh: Shein用了十年时间证明，究竟有多少消费者愿意购买一条5美元的连衣裙。而香港上市首日的表现则表明：消费者愿意买的东西，与股东愿意买的东西，或许完全是两回事。
practice.answer:
1. As the rain continued, temperatures slid sharply and many tourists put on their coats.

2. A lack of experience can undermine a team's competitive advantage in the match.

3. The school scrapped the outdoor event originally scheduled for Friday.

4. The restaurant attracted a large number of young customers with its ultra-low price tags.

5. Bringing in a new partner can provide resources, but it also comes with problems of its own.

6. Her enthusiasm for the job stands in sharp contrast with his indifferent attitude.
